task1_citation_checks.snippet: CONFIRMED REAL (arXiv 2025-02-22; ACL 2025 Findings; aclanthology 2025.findings-acl.1199). 'the log-linear law predicts that the rate of factual hallucination increases linearly with the logarithmic scale of (1) Knowledge Popularity, (2) Knowledge Length, and (3) Model Size'; 'a model's dominant knowledge can obscure less prominent knowledge during generation, causing the model to fabricate.' Functionally matches VERIFY's claim that the frequency/popularity-prior-suppresses-rare-correct-knowledge mechanism (candidate's alpha*log p_pretrain term) is already published as a quantitative law. Match holds.

task1_citation_checks.work: Learning from Emergence: A Study on Proactively Inhibiting the Monosemantic Neurons of Artificial Neural Networks (Wang, Di, Chen, Ng)
task1_citation_checks.snippet: CONFIRMED REAL (arXiv 2023-12-17; KDD '24, Barcelona). Title differs from VERIFY's loose label but same ID/paper. 'the reduction of monosemantic neurons that can only form one-to-one correlations with specific features is a key factor that promotes performance during the increase of scale'; introduces a method to PROACTIVELY suppress monosemantic neurons (causal manipulation). PARTIAL functional match: it genuinely ties the poly<->mono (superposition) transition to scale-driven performance gains and does a causal intervention -- so the de-superposition-promotes-scaling MECHANISM is on record. CAVEAT: it does NOT specifically study emergent-ability SHARP THRESHOLDS nor a per-feature SAE SNR-crossing-AT-the-accuracy-threshold; that sharper instrument is the candidate's residual. So as a 'the underlying mechanism exists' citation it is valid, but it is NOT a verbatim kill of the candidate's specific falsifiable instrument. (Companion citation 2512.13568 below supplies the SAE-order-parameter-for-the-sharp-transition half and is real.) Net: collision at mechanism level is supported, with a noted gap on the exact sharp-threshold instrument.

task1_citation_checks.work: Is the Reversal Curse a Binding Problem? Uncovering Limitations of Transformers from a Basic Generalization Failure (Wang & Sun, OSU)
task1_citation_checks.snippet: CONFIRMED REAL (arXiv 2025-04-02; ICLR 2026; OSU-NLP-Group). 'the Reversal Curse... is a manifestation of the binding problem... two primary causes: the inconsistency and entanglements of concept representations'; fix is a JEPA concept-level architecture. PARTIAL functional match: the paper localizes the curse to a subject<->object ROLE/binding failure (supports VERIFY's 'role-gated' framing), but its thesis is concept-representation entanglement + a JEPA cure, NOT specifically the 'MLP key/value addressing keyed by subject-role, no key(B-as-subject) written' associative-memory mechanism VERIFY attributed to it. The MLP-key-value half of VERIFY's collision is actually carried by OTHER cited works (2311.07468 'key = avg of subject last token'; 2604.04943 'forward/reverse stored as distinct entries'; key-value-memories lineage), which an independent search re-confirmed ('key-value storage method might partially explain the reversal curse'; 'roles being bound to specific positions rather than being role-agnostic'). So the COLLISION as a whole is sound (mechanism is already proposed across the cited set), but 2504.01928 alone does not state the precise key-addressing claim -- a slight over-attribution by VERIFY, not a hallucination.

task3_testability.why: The candidate's testable_prediction is a concrete, falsifiable experiment: track per-feature SAE SNR = margin/interference vs scale; predict the accuracy-50%-crossing coincides with the SNR~1 crossing and is sharp under a CONTINUOUS metric (which also discriminates it from the metric-artifact 'mirage' account); causal arms -- widen only the host layer / add a reserved-subspace auxiliary loss to advance the threshold without changing aggregate CE, and conversely inject interference to delay it; explicit falsification ('FALSIFIED if accuracy emerges at a scale unrelated to the feature SNR crossing, or if forcing a reserved subspace does not advance the threshold'). Measurable order parameter + intervention + falsifier all present. Genuinely testable.

Concrete and falsifiable: per item compute (i) probe-recovered correct-answer signal at the best layer and (ii) pretraining/n-gram log-frequency of true vs emitted token; predict known-but-wrong rate rises monotonically with the distractor's frequency advantage and ~0 when the true token is more frequent (Prediction 1); causal arm -- estimate alpha_hat by regressing logit residuals on log-frequency, subtract alpha_hat*log p_pretrain, and check 'frequency-debiased decoding' selectively recovers the correct answer on >50% of exactly the high-gap cases WITHOUT a probe label and NOT on low-gap cases (Prediction 2); explicit falsifier ('FALSIFIED if known-but-wrong rate is independent of the frequency gap, or if frequency-debiased decoding fails to selectively fix the high-gap cases'). Label-free predictor + causal edit + falsifier all present. Genuinely testable. (Note: testability is moot for niche purposes since Gate 4 = ALREADY_PROPOSED; the question asked was whether they ARE concrete, and they are.)

Independent search (2026 vantage) returned the 2025 survey (2503.05788) and commentary stating 'there remains a lack of consensus on the precise definition of emergent abilities... the scientific debate centers on whether emergent abilities are truly emergent or simply depend on external factors (training dynamics, problem type, metric).' GENUINELY UNRESOLVED on the WHY (why an internally-decodable correct answer is suppressed at output), not merely under-cited. Independent search re-confirmed the empirical effect is solid and striking ('in 9% of questions the internal scoring ranks the ground-truth answer above every incorrect candidate despite the model never generating it across 1,000 attempts' -- Inside-Out 2503.15299) while the INTERPRETATION is openly disputed by multiple visible 2025 papers (2510.09033 knowledge-recall-not-truthfulness; 2510.11905 brittle/superficial) and the original ICLR-2025 paper concedes probes do not generalize across datasets ('multifaceted'). The competing explanations are well-cited, so the contest is genuine, not an artifact of under-citation. CAVEAT: note that a specific proposed MECHANISM for the gap (frequency/prior-override) IS already proposed (2502.16143, 2504.12585) -- so the gap has a candidate mechanism in the literature even though the field has not converged on WHY; the anomaly is 'no accepted account', which is correctly CONTESTED, and the proposed mechanism is correctly ALREADY_PROPOSED. Both calls are consistent.
